inference_scope: Controlled-workload recognition from IPv4 outer-ESP flow metadata only; not inner application identification.

icmpv4.behavior: Bounded count-terminated ICMPv4 profile sequences; captures PC1 outer-interface ESP and PC2 receiver ICMP, checks ping counts and CHILD_SA counters, hashes raw PCAPs, and validates a v2 manifest.

tcp_marker.behavior: One bounded TCP connection carries a deterministic sequence of variable-sized marker messages to a temporary pc2 netcat receiver; receiver byte count and SHA-256 must match the sender.
tcp_marker.note: This is a controlled TCP marker stream, not a TCP echo service or an application implementation.

udp_rtp_http_https_smtp_whatsapp_video.note: Current runner returns fixed synthetic summaries for these categories rather than verifying actual endpoint traffic; exclude from operational training.

proposed_matrix.collection_unit: one experiment capture with an opaque experiment_id, nested in an independently initiated collection session
proposed_matrix.split_unit: collection session; the same session must never appear in multiple splits

workload_conditions.generator_status: bounded configurable generator implemented and smoke-tested; multi-session balanced study remains unexecuted
temporary bounded receiver and sender byte/hash verification implemented and smoke-tested

proposed_matrix.balancing: A pre-registered schedule generator and the 15-session matrix are still required. Profile sequences are recorded exactly; the current smoke examples are not training evidence.

split_plan.strategy: assign whole sessions to train/validation/test before feature inspection
split_plan.seed: record in the immutable collection plan and resulting split manifest

live_smoke_evidence.testbed_independence: Both experiments reused the same running containers and IKE/CHILD SA; they count as one session only.

dataset_preparation.blocker: At least 15 independent session IDs are required for a session-disjoint 60/20/20 split.

per_observation_evidence: raw PCAP path, SHA-256, capture start/end time, interface, inner/outer capture point and IP family
opaque experiment/session IDs and source-control version of generator
independent ground-truth JSON record and how the label was established
requested/effective VPN configuration and machine-readable negotiated IKE/CHILD SA evidence
workload command/configuration, client/server sent and received counts, duration and payload/rate settings
feature schema/extractor versions and data-quality/exclusion result
